title: Account edits, WinCan problems, and daily-log flags
description:
An Owner, a Superintendent, or a manager who was given clearance can edit an account, set a new password without the old one, or delete an account. The signed-in account cannot be deleted.

When a project folder is uploaded, Misc/Docu/Problems/problems.json is indexed onto that job’s daily report.

A daily-log remark keeps its flag instead of being dropped.

Who is affected: pipeshare.live and pipeshare.net on the shared server. The desktop feed stays on 0.3.35.
changeLog: Owner, Superintendent, or a manager with clearance can edit an account, set a new password, or delete an account.
